rationale: The investor demo is near-term; a presentation-substrate pivot would introduce new integration and validation risk on the critical path.
The current IRIS V3 / Stage13 failure is not yet fully explained. Pivoting before owner closure would discard causal information and may replace known problems with unmeasured ones.
The current preset motion/runtime path is already defined around posed 3D geometry and canonical-depth rendering. Preserving it minimizes demo-critical surface area.
The product requirement is source-faithful 2D appearance; the internal route may remain 3D as long as the output contract is met.
